coverageContext: Complete 94-term TPMI Han Chinese model evaluated for gallbladder cholesterolosis (575.6/K82.4). Training used a broader set of biliary/gallbladder diagnoses and abnormal imaging codes; this is not a cholesterolosis-specific development phenotype. Evaluation included only 154 cases and 18,611 controls, with AUROC about 0.722 adjusted for sex, age, array and ten principal components; this is not genetic-only or GA performance. No European evaluation is deposited, so GA withholds European reference ranks. The raw genetic sum does not diagnose gallbladder polyps, distinguish malignancy, predict gallstones, or guide imaging or surgery.
